name: Prior Lake (United States)
description: Purple-blue field charged at the centre with the city seal: a white sailboat on a blue disc within a white ring reading CITY OF PRIOR LAKE MINNESOTA.
history: Prior Lake is an exurban city southwest of Minneapolis, next to Savage and Shakopee in Scott County in Minnesota.
